subject.title: fix(grep): bound file reads with size cap in default grep operations

question: Is an all-or-nothing 50 MiB context cutoff the intended user-facing behavior for grep matches in large regular files, or should the tool preserve context through a bounded range/streaming strategy?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes successful context rendering into empty context for files above a hardcoded threshold; code review cannot establish whether that compatibility tradeoff is the desired product behavior.

options.title: Accept the cutoff
options.body: Keep the 50 MiB cap, document or test the degraded-context contract, and add real runtime proof.

options.title: Preserve large-file context
options.body: Replace the full-file read with a bounded range or streaming approach that can render matched-line context without loading the complete file.

recommendation.title: Accept the cutoff
recommendation.body: Keep the 50 MiB cap, document or test the degraded-context contract, and add real runtime proof.
